Unite under the banner of Super Earth. Unless you're from region-locked countries. We don't want those people (at least according to Sony). Also we've nerfed the drop rates of the premium currency so you're forced to purchase them if you want to keep up with the monthly content drops (the only way to unlock new weaponry).

While the game has a great concept, interesting mechanics that make it stand out from the genre and can be quite fun with friends, there's still plenty of things in need of being ironed out and build upon, which is why I cautiously recommend this game.

But first I'm gonna start off with some positive feedback:
The mission objectives are fun and varied. Side objectives not earning you EXP and money, but also having an impact on your mission through bonus effects are a very nice touch. While you can buy the premium currency for real money, you also earn plenty of it in-game to not worry about it. It is an absolute blast with friends.

Now for the negatives.
-There's no scaling to party size, meaning missions are gonna be a LOT harder when you're playing solo.
-Patrols are sometimes impossible to take out before calling in reinforcements, especially since more heavily-armored enemies can call in reinforcements as well
-Enemies sometimes just pop up randomly instead of burrowing from the ground or getting dropped from ships (depending on the faction), often this popping in is in your immediate vicinity
-Enemies can see you through solid buildings and can even pass through buildings and attack you through them
-If you die in an unfortunate place, your loot and equipment can be unobtainable in a mission
-There is no way of obtaining upgrade materials of a higher rarity without playing on a higher difficulty, making them (and the respective upgrades) permanently unobtainable depending on your style of play. Which doesn't matter too much because
-ship upgrades are a big step-down from the previous game, with only a handful of actually desirable upgrades with a noticable impact on gameplay
-there's no in-game option to check up on enemy information (like their name, weaknesses etc.) which means you have to rely on google if you get a daily mission to take down a certain enemy type if you're not familiar with the name
-damage done to the player is subject to heavy amounts of RNG. the same attack by the same enemy might chip you for 5% of your HP, or it might one-shot you
-patch notes regarding damage reduction (either through armor buffs, or damage nerfs) did absolutely nothing. The same attacks that one-shot you before those patches, still one-shot you, regardless of the armor you're wearing.
-input drops resulting in health recovery items not being used or weapons not reloading are also incredibly frustrating and frequent

Snatching defeat from the jaws of victory with this game. 

This game only gets worse with time, it plays worse, it feels worse, it runs worse, it looks worse. I don't know what on earth they've done with the rendering system but ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ feels like trying to divine knowledge from a crystal ball to get your settings balanced right. 

Also this game is so extremely buggy all the sudden ( ha ). Invisible corpses, rocks and terrain, weird weapon swapping issues, the charging enemies still just slide around at times. 

I could so easily forgive this because this game IS STILL fun, dude, this game is supposed to be silly goofy grunt fantasy in my mind but I fundamentally do not understand nor agree with the balancing and updates to this game. I cannot rationalize the decisions they make, they make no sense. They just forever nerf and gut anything and everything at seemingly random and its such a bummer, if something were egregiously strong it makes sense but even then Id think well that sounds like fun to use and isn't this game supposed to be focused on 'fun' and not some frustrating puzzle of optimizing your loadouts to just get through missions without aggravation. We all understand that difficulty is a piece of the puzzle for enjoyment but it seems like a quest from the devs to make everything a total slog and grind down anything that is being used too often, mistaking something that people enjoy using with something that's too strong over and over again. Lastly on this, this game does a good or even great job at killing you in stupid ways which is a very GOOD thing, it adds to the feeling that you're just a dispensable acolyte of something so much larger than yourself; There is also a inherent means by which this game plays where you can become really good at avoiding stupid deaths, staying away from falling titans, positioning yourself to not be knocked into a pit of enemies if you get toppled over and it feels really good when it works. The difficulty of this game has always come from that aspect to me, you can become better though understanding rather than just raw talent at gunplay or reaction time. So when they decide to slowly and methodically strip away all your tools to handle situations, it starts making the game feel artificially difficult, it adds friction to the enjoyment rather than challenge.

Id say this game is still for the most part pretty dang fun and you can get a ton of enjoyment out of it, but with every update that comes out your options to get that enjoyment become more and more limited, they want you to play the game the way THEY envision rather than allowing it to come through organically. Its just sad I guess.

Also they've gotten pretty grubby about the microtransactions, which is like whatever get your bag king but also I dislike having to do the most boring grind in the world of collecting super credits just to get more of the content in the game I paid for. Still, kudos that you can at least access those things by playing. I just hope the Warhammer cross over is dope.

This game is INSANELY fun!! The enemies are genuinely terrifying and realistic. The explosions and stuff look AMAZING. All the weapons feel smooth and you can really feel the difference between weapons. The game is highly focused on team play and I think it's genius that friendly fire is always on in a game like this. You can wipe your whole team if you call something in just a little too close. The planets are always changing and the environments are always so cool. I love the idea of the stratagems because it adds an entirely new level to a shooter like this. You have to really prepare and know what you're going into, and then you need to weigh your options because different stratagems are good for different things. You can only bring in 4, so communication really helps make sure everything is covered. I have always loved strategy games like Command and Conquer, Civilization, and quite a few different tower defense games, and I have always loved shooters but this is the first time I am able to play both at the same time. This game is like Gears of War meets Terminator meets Starship Troopers meets tower defense and strategy games, and it's absolutely incredible. I cannot wait to see what comes in the future for this game!!

I highly recommend this game, it are still having some launch issues on and off but I have to say I can't remember the last time I had this much fun in game. It looks absolutely stunning and the scenery and atmosphere in the game really captures that feeling that you are in the thick of it. You get these calm periods and all of the sudden all hell breaks loose and there are enemies everywhere. 

I am loving every minute of playing this game and I hope they manage to keep the content coming to further broaden the experience. But the game is easily worth the 40€ it is currently being charged for. Solo playing is ok but the game really shines when you are playing with friends, so I highly recommend getting some friends together. If you enjoy horde coop shooters you are for sure going to have a blast with this one.

Most bug issues have been fixed but there's still a long way to go. Devs are great, working hard to make the game better and you can tell this game is made with love. 

Edit: Changing to negative because the only thing true now about my previous statement is that there's a long way to go.
